links.outcome: Recommendation quality under amplified case complexity stress-testing
links.effect: Recommendation quality degraded by 7.4% under amplified complexity, while rationality (+2.0%), readability (+1.7%) and diagnosis (+4.7%) marginally improved.
links.quote: Multidimensional stress-testing exposed model-specific vulnerabilities, with recommendation quality degrading by 7.4% under amplified complexity.
